QuestInfo.name: [Arteria] Chill Space
QuestInfo.1: The top deck of the battleship is filled with strange soldiers made of ice. Who could they be? Defeat them and keep moving forward.
QuestInfo.2: You're one step closer to finding the Empress. Almost there.
QuestInfo.0: Your allies have forced the enemy out of your way. Now it's time for you to finish the mission alone. Go to the top deck and save the Empress.
